LanguageData.AutoArm_ConfirmReset: Are you sure you want to reset all settings to defaults?
LanguageData.AutoArm_SettingsReset: Auto Arm settings reset to defaults.
LanguageData.AutoArm_EnableModDesc: Colonists automatically equip better weapons based on their apparel policy.
LanguageData.AutoArm_ShowNotificationsDesc: Show a message when a colonist equips or upgrades a weapon.
LanguageData.AutoArm_ShowForcedLabelsDesc: Adds a "forced" label to weapon names that have been manually assigned to a colonist, and marks the right-click option as force equip.
LanguageData.AutoArm_DisableDuringRaidsDesc: Pauses auto equip during raids and other major threats.
LanguageData.AutoArm_OnlyEquipFromStorageDesc: Colonists only auto equip weapons from stockpiles, shelves, and other storage. Ignores weapons lying on the ground.
LanguageData.AutoArm_UpgradeEquippedWeaponsDesc: Colonists swap their weapons for better ones when available. Turn off to stop all upgrading, including sidearm upgrades. Empty hands and empty sidearm slots still get filled.
LanguageData.AutoArm_AllowForcedWeaponUpgradesDesc: Colonists can upgrade forced weapons to better quality versions of the same type, like a normal revolver to a masterwork one.
LanguageData.AutoArm_AllowTemporaryColonistsDesc: Temporary colonists without equipment restrictions (refugees, borrowed pawns) can auto equip weapons.
LanguageData.AutoArm_ForceWeaponDesc: Bonded persona weapons are automatically marked as forced, preventing automatic switching.
LanguageData.AutoArm_EnableSidearmAutoEquipDesc: Allows colonists to automatically pick up additional weapons as sidearms.
LanguageData.AutoArm_AllowSidearmUpgradesDesc: Colonists will swap sidearms for better ones when available.
LanguageData.AutoArm_RequireAmmunitionDesc: Colonists only pick up weapons if they have access to appropriate ammunition.
LanguageData.AutoArm_SimpleSidearmsReflectionFailed: ⚠ SimpleSidearms integration failed, sidearm features disabled.
LanguageData.AutoArm_ThresholdDesc: How much better a weapon needs to be before colonists will switch. Lower values mean more frequent switching.
LanguageData.AutoArm_WeaponPreferenceDesc: Bias all colonists toward ranged or melee weapons.
LanguageData.AutoArm_AllowChildrenToEquipWeaponsDesc: Slide left to automate your child militia earlier, slide right for boring safety. Kids also somehow bypass all weapon weight checks. Definitely not a bug.
LanguageData.AutoArm_MinimumAgeDesc: Minimum age to start auto equipping weapons.
LanguageData.AutoArm_ColonistsValidActiveTooltip: AutoArm can hand these colonists a weapon job right now.
LanguageData.AutoArm_ColonistsValidBusyTooltip: Managed, but drafted, mid job or otherwise occupied. They equip when free.
LanguageData.AutoArm_ColonistsInvalidTooltip: AutoArm won't arm these colonists. Hover a row for the reason.
LanguageData.AutoArm_RaidPausedBanner: Auto equip paused while a raid is active
LanguageData.AutoArm_AllWeaponsTooltip: Every weapon AutoArm considers. Biocoded weapons are excluded.
LanguageData.AutoArm_NoValidWeapons: No suitable weapons available on map
LanguageData.AutoArm_ThinkTreeInjectionFailed: AutoArm: Think tree injection failed, mod won't work. Please report this.
